mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC over last 2 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in last 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 100k), labor market overheating drives wage inflation, prompting Fed tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 100k, or Rank IC over last 2 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in industrial production (INDPRO > 115.0) signals robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 115.0, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1300 thousand units (HOUST < 1300) signals housing market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1300, or Rank IC over last 2 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%), the Fed maintains restrictive policy, suppressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC over last 2 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment (UNRATE < 4.7%) indicates a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and corporate costs, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.05.
